name: Red Sea International Airport

handling.v: Jetex is licensed by GACA for ground handling and business aviation support (announced 16 Dec 2025)
handling.quote: Jetex has been awarded a license to provide ground handling and business aviation support services at RSI.

notes: Only the GACA news item of 16 Dec 2025 (gaca.gov.sa/en/News/Jetex-ground-handling-at-Red-Sea-Airport) gave an official fact. No operator rules page, conditions of use or AIP page found; the Saudi eAIP (aimss.sans.com.sa) could not be opened. 'RSI' appears in the GACA item only as an abbreviation, not stated as the IATA code.
